title: Nvidia’s stock closes the week down 14 percent, as Reuters reports the SEC is looking into its “accounting practices.”
summary: After the company’s stock closed Thursday at a 52-week low , it dropped to $125.53 on Friday, which CNBC reports marks the seventh straight week of dropping share prices .
